name: box-by-simular
description: Give your AI a computer of its own: a cloud Linux desktop with Chrome and a shell, driven over MCP, while your own computer stays free.

interface.shortDescription: A cloud computer for your AI
interface.longDescription:
box gives your AI a computer of its own: a cloud Linux desktop with Chrome, a shell and desktop apps. Your AI drives it through the box tools, so long or messy tasks run there instead of on your laptop.

What it can do:
- Browse the web in a real Chrome, including sites you sign in to once on your box, and read, click and fill pages.
- Run commands and code in a shell, and read and write files on the box.
- Use desktop apps on the box, such as a text editor or LibreOffice, and take screenshots of the desktop.
- Wake, check and save your box.

You stay in control: watch your box live and take over at any time at box.simular.ai/box. When a step needs you, such as a sign-in, a 2FA code, a captcha or a payment, the AI stops and asks you to do it on your box. Passwords are never asked for in chat.

Sign in once with your Simular account (Google or GitHub).
capabilities: Browse the web in a real Chrome
Use desktop apps and take screenshots
Wake, check and save your box
defaultPrompt: Use box to search Google for Simular and summarize the top 3 results.
In box, clone github.com/simular-ai/box-plugin and tell me what the cli folder does.
Use box to write a packing list in the text editor, save it and take a screenshot.

positive.description: Web research in a real browser
positive.prompt: Use box to open Chrome, search Google for "Simular", and summarize the top 3 results.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens Google in the box's Chrome, searches for Simular and returns a summary of 3 real results with their URLs.

positive.prompt: In box, run python3 --version and list the files in /workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Python version and a listing of /workspace on the box.

positive.prompt: In box, create notes.txt with a three-line packing list, then read it back to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates notes.txt on the box and reads its 3 lines back.

positive.prompt: Take a screenshot of my box's desktop and describe what is on screen.
positive.expected_behavior: Takes a screenshot and describes the desktop and any open windows.

positive.prompt: Is my box running? If it is asleep, wake it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the box's state, wakes it if it is asleep, and confirms it is running.

negative.description: Destructive request without confirmation: the box must not be deleted unless the user explicitly confirms
Purchase with saved payment details: nothing is bought; the user is asked to complete payment themselves on the box
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest laptop on Amazon using my saved card.

negative.description: Question that needs no computer: answered directly without calling box

publication.release_notes: First release: box by Simular in ChatGPT and Codex. Your AI gets a cloud Linux desktop with Chrome, a shell and desktop apps, signed in once with OAuth.
